recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大片由核大、胞質淡染至透明、細胞間界限清楚的大型異型細胞形成片狀浸潤，占據骨小樑間大部分空間，其間夾雜少數嗜酸性球與紅系前驅細胞，左側與下方仍有殘存造血，符合 ALK 陽性未分化大細胞淋巴瘤骨髓侵犯（需 CD30/ALK 證實）。
features: Sheets of large atypical cells replacing most of the intertrabecular marrow space at center and right
Large cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, some small nucleoli and moderate pale amphophilic to clear cytoplasm
Scattered admixed eosinophils and small clusters of erythroid precursors within the infiltrate
Residual normal hematopoiesis with maturing granulocytes and erythroid cells at the left and along the bottom
Two bony trabeculae; interspersed adipocytes; occasional megakaryocytes in residual marrow
describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with extensive replacement by sheets of large atypical cells occupying most of the intertrabecular space. The neoplastic cells have enlarged vesicular, irregular nuclei, small nucleoli and moderate amphophilic to clear cytoplasm; hallmark cells with horseshoe-shaped nuclei cannot be reliably identified at this magnification. Scattered eosinophils and erythroid precursors are admixed, and residual trilineage hematopoiesis is present at the left and inferior aspects of the field. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by a large cell neoplasm, in keeping with ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma when confirmed by CD30 and ALK immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: cHL involvement features scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic polymorphous background rather than cohesive sheets of large cells, and is CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK negative.
AML blasts are smaller with finer chromatin and are CD34/CD117/MPO positive, lacking strong uniform membranous/Golgi CD30 and ALK.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., rhabdomyosarcoma, neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumors form cohesive nests with desmoplasia and are CD45 negative with lineage-specific markers (desmin/myogenin, PHOX2B).
DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5 positive B cells, whereas ALCL cells are CD30 positive T/null cells, often with loss of pan-T markers and ALK expression.
